M21 — 2026-10-12
Cloud lane round trip without the Claude GitHub App (drive-lanes 5.1, 2026-10-12, claude 2.1.296): launch with `script -q <log> claude --cloud "<prompt>"` from a local checkout (the session gets a bundle of local HEAD, no remote, so push fails); `claude -p <msg> --cloud <id>` only posts a message and prints {ok,session_id,url}; readback is `claude --teleport <id> -p "." --model haiku --output-format json` (no pty needed, ~$0.017, ~$0.24 on the default model), which writes the WHOLE cloud transcript to ~/.claude/projects/<cwd>/<new-local-id>.jsonl: tool results verbatim (take a `git format-patch` from there, then `git am`), the final reply, and a `system` record at each turn end
